The files in this folder are data of GeoSphere Austria, from its Data Hub,
https://data.hub.geosphere.at, dataset "nowcast-v1-15min-1km"
(Kurzfristwettervorhersagen für Österreich, DOI 10.60669/ahad-4y43). The
dataset's page, https://data.hub.geosphere.at/dataset/nowcast-v1-15min-1km,
read on 2026-11-21, names its licence: "Creative Commons Namensnennung 4.0
International". The Data Hub's legal page, https://data.hub.geosphere.at/legal
(the German text is the binding one), read on the same day, says: "Soweit
der/die Datenempfänger:in die von der GeoSphere Austria erstellten Daten
verwendet, hat er/sie die GeoSphere Austria als Urheberin und
Rechteinhaberin in folgender Weise nennen: „Datenquelle: GeoSphere Austria -
https://data.hub.geosphere.at“." They are not covered by the licence of
the code around them.

They were recorded on 2026-11-21 from
https://dataset.api.hub.geosphere.at/v1/grid/forecast/nowcast-v1-15min-1km,
without an account or a key, with curl. Each is the whole answer to one
request, unchanged:

    metadata.json   GET .../nowcast-v1-15min-1km/metadata
                    asked at 12:39:13 UTC, 1,588 bytes: the dataset's
                    description and the six runs the service holds, by
                    their reference times, 11:00 to 12:15 UTC

    rr-202611211200.nc   407,953 bytes
                    GET ...?parameters=rr&bbox=46.3,9.4,48.5,17.2
                        &forecast_offset=1
                        &start=2026-11-21T12:00&end=2026-11-21T12:00
                        &output_format=netcdf
                    asked at 12:39:13 UTC, answered some 14 seconds later

    rr-202611211215.nc   407,258 bytes
                    GET ...?parameters=rr&bbox=46.3,9.4,48.5,17.2
                        &forecast_offset=0
                        &start=2026-11-21T12:15&end=2026-11-21T12:15
                        &output_format=netcdf
                    asked at 12:39:28 UTC, answered some 7 seconds later

Each of the two is the first step of one run of INCA's nowcast, the step at
the run's own reference time: the precipitation sum "rr" in kg m-2 of the
quarter of an hour that ends then, for the part of the model's grid of one
kilometre (EPSG:31287, MGI / Austria Lambert) that the box of the first
region asks for: 600 by 252 points, 151,200 values (the answer's header
datapoint-count). The files are netCDF-4, which is HDF5. The box is asked
for and not the whole domain because the service lets a request name one;
the whole domain is 701 by 431 points.

Not kept here, asked on the same day to learn how the service behaves:
the list of all datasets, the metadata of inca-v1-1h-1km and
inca-v2-1h-1km, the Data Hub's catalogue entries, four requests for a
handful of points as GeoJSON, the list of runs twice more, and one first
try at the NetCDF answer. Fourteen requests to the dataset service in
all, these three among them; its own counter showed 11 used of the 240 an
hour it allows.

sha256:
    31a95b46147b20f0ea9303b1fba1bd75f6f1eec19d01ab038d3a8f81e9741b4c  metadata.json
    26513633c7825945fb284f5dddb497db7d64a881d575b69335611f6ae97ccf65  rr-202611211200.nc
    12a22ec5a0bee2d292154bb9874b5299a900573f80af1d12335da1489f3e5557  rr-202611211215.nc

A frame is an analysis: rain as a model put it together from radars and
gauges. It is no statement that a place is dry, or that it can be flown.
